description: This file defines data structures and logic related to wake word detection and command extraction in a voice recognition system. It includes structs for wake word segments, configuration, and match results, as well as a core implementation of wake word matching logic. Additionally, it provides optional functionality for integrating with speech transcription segments.

classes.name: WakeWordSegment
classes.description: Represents a segment of spoken wake word with timing and text information.

classes.name: WakeWordGateConfig
classes.description: Configuration parameters for wake word detection, including triggers and timing constraints.

classes.name: WakeWordGateMatch
classes.description: Result structure indicating a detected wake word and associated command.

classes.name: WakeWordGate
classes.description: Core logic for matching wake words in transcripts using trigger tokens and segments.

classes.name: WakeWordSpeechSegments
classes.description: Utility that converts speech transcription segments into WakeWordSegment objects; only available if Speech framework is imported.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Attempts to find a wake word trigger and extract the command text based on the transcript, segments, and configuration.

methods.name: commandText
methods.description: Constructs command text from segments following the trigger end time.

methods.name: matchesTextOnly
methods.description: Checks whether the given text contains any of the trigger phrases, case-insensitive.

methods.name: stripWake
methods.description: Removes trigger phrases from a text string.

methods.name: normalizeTriggers
methods.description: Converts trigger phrases into normalized token lists for matching.

methods.name: normalizeSegments
methods.description: Converts speech segments into normalized tokens for matching.

methods.name: normalizeToken
methods.description: Normalizes a single token(string) by trimming and lowercasing.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Converts SFTranscription segments into WakeWordSegment objects, if Speech framework is available.
